label: early original-phase inputs 0 / i (also n, x, w) at steps 2-5
explanation: Reset-gate unit that fires almost only in the original (input) phase (98.7% of mass), peaking at steps 2-5 (96% of mass; t=3 alone 41%). It never fires at t=0, at the <DEL> step, or meaningfully in the copy phase. Which input token is present scales it in a graded way: 0 (31% rate, 32% of mass) and i (28%, 27% of mass) are strongest, then n, x, w, then a long weak tail of other letters. The top activations are almost all 0 or i at t=2-4 (the 0/i-only predicate has precision 0.90 and covers 80% of the top quartile). A first occurrence of the token helps a little (in_first lift 1.7x), and a preceding 2/0/i helps somewhat. The 5-token predicate gets dev F1 0.59 and mass recall 0.75. What it misses is mostly small activations on other letters at t=2-5, and its false positives are n/x/w/0 in weaker contexts, so the unit acts like a graded mix of position and token rather than a sharp boolean.
